channel_info.title: Dallas Willard Ministries
channel_info.description: Dallas Willard revolutionized how we think about the true meaning of discipleship. One of the most brilliant Christian thinkers of our times and author of the acclaimed The Divine Conspiracy, Dallas skillfully weaves together philosophy, biblical teaching, popular culture, science, scholarship, and spiritual practice, revealing what it means to "apprentice" ourselves to Jesus. This channel brings together videos of his teaching with the aim of helping you "grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ" (2 Peter 3:18).

playlists.title: Knowing Christ: Living in Christ's Presence
playlists.description:
“Who is to bring the knowledge that will answer the great life questions that perplex humanity?” According to Dallas Willard, “The primary responsibility to teach falls upon those who self-identify as spokespeople for Christ…”

The "Knowing Christ" conference was hosted by the Dallas Willard Center in Santa Barbara, California, February 21-23, 2013. Dallas Willard and John Ortberg took turns teaching, and at the end of each session John moderated a wonderful dialogue with Dallas, teasing out further insight and clarity about the topics at hand. Links to the outlines distributed to the conference participants can be downloaded from each session description.

The plan for the gathering was to assist pastors (spokespeople for Christ) in fully entering into the joy, power, and dignity of the role assigned to them by Christ, to be the teachers of the nations. The conference focused on knowledge for living and the disastrous effects of divorcing the teachings of Jesus Christ and his people from the domain of human knowledge. It was designed to help pastors and other Christian leaders present a clearer picture of how to live well and how to "do" church.

These session recordings were released in DVD and audio, and transcribed in book form under the title "Living in Christ's Presence." Learn more about the book and about the leader's guide on our website: https://dwillard.org/resources/books/living-in-christs-presence

playlists.title: Divine Conspiracy Interviews
playlists.description:
Dallas was a guest for two interviews on James and Betty Robison's "Life Today" talk show in 2011. Most of what they discussed was reflecting thoughts from The Divine Conspiracy.

Filmed October 11-12, 2011

Learn more about LIFE Today ministries at https://lifetoday.org

playlists.title: The Soul Series
playlists.description:
This is a 3-part sermon series presented by Dallas Willard at his home church in August of 1990. 
Dallas says the series works through three topics that are intimately related: The soul (session 1), God (session 2), and Prayer (session 3).

It is very difficult for us to conceptualize the worth of a soul. It is especially difficult for us today. The process of history and teaching and thought has leached out of our minds the very things we need to think about what a soul is.

Dallas defines the soul as: “the unity and substance of your life. It's what makes you tick. It is the overall order or disorder that moves and organizes through your experiences. That's what your soul is. It is a power to live; and, as it goes along, it picks up the result of the experience.”

playlists.title: Holy Living
playlists.description: Dallas gave two presentations at the Azusa Pacific University School of Theology's 2010 Malcolm R. Robertson Lectureship on Holy Living. Recorded September 20, 2010.

playlists.title: Neighborhood Initiative
playlists.description:
In January of 2001, some of the pastors from the west valley of Los Angeles began gathering to pray for the city and the churches that make up the whole Church in the San Fernando valley. It was their commitment from the beginning to pray, to develop relationships with one another, and to wait on the Lord to show them what He had in mind for them to do. He led them to minister together in the neighborhoods where those in our churches live. This ministry has become known as Neighborhood Initiative.

Resources are available for pastors and leaders interested in implementing their own neighborhood initiative in their cities. Visit https://neighborhoodinitiative.com

playlists.title: Willard-Hildebrand Colloquium 2023
playlists.description:
On June 7-9, 2023, Westmont College hosted a colloquium to study and compare the ethical and moral teachings of Dallas Willard and Dietrich von Hildebrand. Colloquium participants had been studying the work of these two men together for 3 years leading up to this gathering. 

Papers were presented on the following topics:
1. Corporeality, the Body, and Moral Knowledge
2. The Effects of the Disappearance of Moral Knowledge on Virtue Acquisition
3: Drifting Into Goodness
4:  Hildebrand and the Disappearance of Moral Knowledge
5: The Engines of the Zeitgeist- How the Old Moral Knowledge Has Been Replaced
6: Mediating Institutions and Hildebrandian Value Response

This event was co-sponsored the the Hildebrand Project, the Martin Institute, and Dallas Willard Ministries.

Schedule of Speakers and Topics: https://dwillard.s3.us-west-1.amazonaws.com/2023+Willard_Hildebrand+Colloqium.pdf

playlists.title: Pastor to Pastor Conversations
playlists.description:
On January 19, 2006, HB London, Dallas Willard and John Ortberg offered godly counsel to help ministry leaders face the challenges of maintaining a healthy spiritual life, but their advice is of great value for people in all walks of life. 

We are grateful to our friends at the Christian Communication Network for sharing these recordings from their Pastor to Pastor leadership series.

playlists.title: Small Group Study: Hearing God
playlists.description:
Dallas Willard Ministries is pleased to offer free access to this 6-video series for use in small group studies based on the teaching in Dallas Willard's highly acclaimed book "Hearing God: Developing a Conversational Relationship with God." 

Each 30-minute session incorporates teaching from Dallas along with conversations with Richard Foster and John Ortberg . After a break for discussion in your small group, there is a 10-minute bonus teaching for those who would like to dig a little deeper. We hope you will gather a group of friends to watch this together and discuss the ways you are growing in your conversational relationship with God.

Download the Small Group Leaders' Guide by Gary Moon: https://dwillard.s3.us-west-1.amazonaws.com/Hearing-God-Small-Group-Curriculum-Guide.pdf

See the preview video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uucUAQDsnbI&list=UU71cHCubNTVifOiU2RiDd_g&index=3

SERIES CONTENT:
Session 1 - You Were Created for Intimate Friendship with God
      Bonus - Hearing God Is More than Guidance
Session 2 - What Hearing God Is Not
      Bonus - The Stepford Wives
Session 3 - Trinitarian Fellowship: The Word, The Spirit, and Life Together
      Bonus - To Live Is Christ
Session 4 - The Still Small Voice and Its Rivals
      Bonus - How I Hear God
Session 5 - Hearing God in the Context of the Kingdom of God
      Bonus - Listening to God Is More than a Discipline
Session 6 - Hearing God as Life
      Bonus - Conversation, Communion, and Union

LEARN MORE ABOUT THIS TOPIC: Visit our website to learn more about Dallas's book, Hearing God, and other resources that will help you develop a conversational relationship with God: https://dwillard.org/books/hearing-god

#DallasWillard #HearingGod #JohnOrtberg #RichardFoster #SmallGroup #GaryMoon

playlists.title: Celebrating the 20th Anniversary of Renovation of the Heart
playlists.description:
April 2022 marks the 20th anniversary of the publication of Dallas Willard's Renovation of the Heart. The Willard Family, Dallas Willard Ministries, NavPress and SPCK Publishers are celebrating this milestone with the release of a new edition of Renovation of the Heart. We’ve also invited 20 Christian leaders from around the world to share their reflections on how this incredible book has impacted their lives and the Church at large over the past 20 years. Be watching for a new video in this series to be posted every Monday for 20 weeks.

Celebrate Renovation of the Heart with us! 
Visit our website to learn more about this life-changing book that was written to encourage and spur us on in our daily discipleship and ongoing journey towards Christlikeness: https://dwillard.org/books/renovation-of-the-heart
On this page you will find:
1. A complete description of what Renovation of the Heart is all about. 
2. Links to purchase your own copy in your preferred format and language.
3. Links to FREE resources that will help you study the book on your own or with friends (including the Renovaré Book Club beginning March 28).
4. Links to other books that will help you practice what you learn.

Visit the Renovare website to hear a podcast about Jan Johnson's work with Dallas, this book, and get some good advice about ways we can apply the Renovation of the Heart material in our own lives:  
https://renovare.org/podcast/jan-johnson-practicing-renovation

playlists.title: Knowledge of Christ in Today's World
playlists.description:
This 8-part series, presented by Dallas Willard on June 26-27, 2003, became the foundation for the book “Knowing Christ Today.” At the time, Dallas had begun writing an academic book called “The Disappearance of Moral Knowledge,” and he saw this series as a way to help the church community understand the reasons for his concern about the loss of moral knowledge in our culture. He concludes the teaching by pointing out the important role pastors and the Church play in redeeming this situation. 

Dallas said he hoped that one outcome of this teaching is that when we see the phrase "knowledge of God," we will understand it as "interactive relationship with God." If you would like to dig deeper into the topics presented here, visit us at https://DWillard.org to learn about the books "Knowing Christ Today" and "The Disappearance of Moral Knowledge," and many other related resources.

This was recorded at a weekend retreat hosted in the home of generous apprentices of Christ who wanted to produce a video series for the simple purpose of allowing more people to learn from Dallas. We are incredibly grateful for this gift!


Be sure to download Dallas's handouts so you can follow along. https://dwillard.s3.us-west-1.amazonaws.com/Knowledge+Of+Christ+In+Todays+World+2003+Notes.pdf

#DallasWillard #KnowingChrist #MoralKnowledge #Disappearanceofmoralknowledge

playlists.title: From Forgiveness to Blessing
playlists.description: On May 11, 1996, Dallas spent a Saturday morning at the Presbyterian Church of the Master in Mission Viejo, CA, teaching on the topic of forgiveness. You'll find encouragement, hope and freedom as Dallas shares definitions and practical steps to understand forgiveness, be able to receive and extend forgiveness, and ultimately live our daily life with God in a continual flow of blessing.

playlists.title: Living in the Divine Conversation and Character: Renovaré Institute week #2 at St. Malo’s Retreat Center
playlists.description:
The Renovaré Institute for Christian Spiritual Formation is a two-year online and in-person school that provides students with a solid framework for understanding and living out Christian Spiritual Formation. For the first 3 years of the Institute, Dallas was able to teach 2 residency weeks per year. The theme of this course segment was "Living in the Divine Conversation and Character" or, more simply stated, "Hearing God."

We are grateful to our friends at Renovaré for allowing us to post this series on our channel. To learn more about the Institute, please visit https://renovare.org/institute.

Filmed March 15-18, 2011

Please refer to the “Renovare Institute Series” playlist for the October 2010 teachings.

playlists.title: Beyond Belief
playlists.description:
This 2-day conference was held at Grace Fellowship in Maryland on May 1-2, 1998. In titling the conference "Beyond Belief," Dallas was referring to the fact that we can live a life that encompasses what we read in the Bible and hear in our Christian teaching - a life that is beyond belief! 

There are six audio-only sessions from the conference that we have published here as videos with slides. The first 4 sessions are divided into 2 parts.

1) Who You Are, Why You Are Here
2) Getting the Good News Right
3) Apprentices of Jesus
4) What the Spiritual Disciplines Are
5) Spending One Day with Jesus
6) Prayer - What it is and How it Works

playlists.title: Renovaré Institute Series
playlists.description:
The Renovaré Institute for Christian Spiritual Formation is a two-year online and in-person school that provides students with a solid framework for understanding and living out Christian Spiritual Formation. For the first 3 years of the Institute, Dallas was able to teach 2 residency weeks per year. This series was recorded during the first residency week of the second cohort in October 2010. Please refer to the “Living in the Divine Conversation and Character” playlist for Dallas's teaching in the next residency week, March 2011.

We are grateful to our friends at Renovaré for allowing us to post these series on our channel. To learn more about the Institute, please visit https://renovare.org/institute. New cohorts begin every year in August.

playlists.title: For Such a Time As This
playlists.description: Priceless, timely wisdom for ministry leaders & volunteers, educators, parents, business leaders…all those working with Jesus to multiply His Apprentices!  Dr. Willard shared these messages at the Baylor University and Truitt Seminary church staff retreat February 23-24, 2004.

playlists.title: Hearing God in Real Life
playlists.description:
These four teaching sessions are from a weekend Hearing God retreat presented on August 5-6, 2011 at St. Peter's Anglican Church in Alabama. 

Dallas takes the idea of hearing God out of the context of religion and puts it in the context of real life. Then he provides a solid theological foundation for discussing the idea of hearing God.

playlists.title: Authentic Leader Series
Kingdom Living
playlists.description:
The Kingdom Living Series aka “It’s a Wonderful Life” was done in 1999 at the Valley Vineyard. The six sessions have been divided into thirteen segmentsfor easier viewing.
SESSION 1: Walking in the Character and Power of God (full session)
SESSION 2: The Basis for Death to Self for Kingdom Living (3 segments)
SESSION 3: How to Be in the World but not of It (2 segments)
SESSION 4: The New Kind of Human Life and Its Community (3 segments)
SESSION 5: Learning Kingdom Love (2 segments)
SESSION 6: The word of the Kingdom as a Life Force (full session)

playlists.title: The Divine Conspiracy
playlists.description: Dallas Willard’s classic, “The Divine Conspiracy” was published in 1998 and was awarded Book of the Year by Christianity Today. A study in the Sermon on the Mount, it was subtitled, “Rediscovering Our Hidden Life in God.”  To make his message more accessible, this 12-part video series was funded through The Harvey Fellows 2007 Summer Institute under the title of "Text, Context and the Soul." The goal here is to present discipleship to Jesus as an interactive life in the Kingdom of God and the gospel (Good News!) for our life now. It is a life available to “whosoever will.”

playlists.title: Denver Seminary Spiritual Formation 611 - 17 Parts
playlists.description:
Dallas Willard taught this intensive seminary course in 2010 on the psychology of redemption (SF611) titled, "The Human Contribution to Holiness: What is Our Part in Putting Off the Old Person and Putting on the New."  Presented in 17 parts, the course objectives were to appropriate the teachings of Jesus in real life, to practice several spiritual disciplines, to experience personal renewal and to equip leaders in their roles in local congregations. 
Syllabus: https://dwillard.s3-us-west-1.amazonaws.com/2010_SF611_DenverSeminarySyllabus.pdf
#WillardWednesday

playlists.title: Philosophy and Apologetics
playlists.description: Dallas’s knowledge of philosophy and theology, along with his background in psychology and science (his first B.A. was in Psychology and his Ph.D. work included a Minor in the History of Science), were a potent combination that prompted invitations to teach around the world in diverse areas, Christian and “secular,” with a unique perspective and gentle authority. Dallas explained that the intersection between his philosophical and Christian teachings could be found in the simple question: Who are you becoming?

playlists.title: Good Friday
playlists.description: Dallas Willard teaching about Good Friday.

playlists.title: The Disappearance of Moral Knowledge
playlists.description:
Dallas Willard believed that the loss of moral teaching in our culture is having devastating effects and must be addressed, which is why he wrote The Disappearance of Moral Knowledge. After the publication of the book, Dallas’s family and colleagues created the Moral Knowledge Initiative to allow for opportunities to discuss the book’s concepts in academic and community settings: looking at what has happened in our culture historically and seeking ways to address the problems we now face. Visit www.MoralKnowledgeInitiative.org to learn more.

This playlist begins with a wonderful overview of the teaching in the book by Dallas himself, followed by a Q&A that brings in real-world examples about how to respond. The next 7 videos are of the papers and responses given at the 2019 Disappearance of Moral Knowledge symposium held May 14-15, 2019, at Biola University’s Center for Christian Thought. See a synopsis of the symposium, complete with links to the papers presented, at https://dwillard.org/articles/disappearance-of-moral-knowledge-symposium-1-summary

playlists.title: Healing the Heart and Life by Walking with Jesus Daily
playlists.description:
"Healing the Heart and Life by Walking with Jesus Daily" is a 6-week series presented by Dallas Willard at his home church shortly after the publication of "Renovation of the Heart."  Here Dallas explains the progression from a life of brokenness to a life of discipleship in God's kingdom by showing us how we can pursue restoration of our souls. Each meeting is presented here in 2 parts, so there are 12 videos total. 

Recorded September 23 - October 28, 2003 at Valley Vineyard Christian Church in Reseda, CA.
